tickerText: [TENNIS] US Open Round of 16 begins Sunday — Zheng rallied past Keys, Cerundolo stunned Fritz, Gauff and Andreeva advance; Sabalenka vs Townsend and Paul vs Alcaraz headline Ashe • [SQUASH] London Classic finals at Alexandra Palace — Georgina Kennedy faces defending champion Amina Orfi, Paul Coll meets Victor Crouin after Saturday's semi-finals • [BADMINTON] China Masters finals day in Shenzhen — An Se-young vs Tomoka Miyazaki in women's singles; historic all-Hong Kong men's final between Lee Cheuk Yiu and Jason Gunawan • [PICKLEBALL] Veolia Nationals Championship Sunday in Cary — pro gold and bronze medal matches from 10am ET on PickleballTV and Tennis Channel • [TABLE TENNIS] HYLO ETTU Champions League Stage 2 Round of 16 set — Saarbrücken vs Lille Metropole among eight home-and-away ties after Lille group stage

newsItems.title: US Open Round of 16 Begins
newsItems.excerpt: Flushing Meadows enters the second week — Qinwen Zheng rallied from a set down to beat Madison Keys, Francisco Cerundolo stunned Taylor Fritz, and Coco Gauff advanced as Sabalenka vs Townsend and Paul vs Alcaraz headline Sunday.

newsItems.title: London Classic Finals Day
newsItems.excerpt: The PSA Gold event crowns champions at Alexandra Palace — Georgina Kennedy faces defending champion Amina Orfi after upsetting world No. 1 Hania El Hammamy, while Paul Coll meets Victor Crouin in the men's final.

newsItems.title: Veolia Nationals Championship Sunday
newsItems.excerpt: The PPA Slam in Cary decides pro gold and bronze medals today — Championship Sunday runs from 10am ET on PickleballTV and Tennis Channel to open the 2026-27 tour season.

newsItems.title: Champions League Stage 2 Draw Set
newsItems.excerpt: The HYLO ETTU Champions League Men Round of 16 is set after Stage 1 in Lille — 1. FC Saarbrücken face Lille Metropole among eight home-and-away ties as Europe's top clubs chase the Final Four.
